name: chat-experience
description: Chat flow verification: load chat page, interact with threads API, create a thread, and evaluate the chat UX.

steps.prompt: Navigate to the chat page on the gateway
Verify the chat page loads and the chat interface is visible
Fetch existing chat threads from the API

steps.body: {"title":"E2E Test Thread","message":"Hello from the chat-experience playbook"}
steps.prompt: Create a new chat thread with an initial message
Verify the threads endpoint returns 200 after thread creation
Reload the chat page to verify the new thread appears
Verify the newly created thread is visible in the thread list
steps.expected: thread list with new thread visible

steps.prompt: Evaluate the chat UX: Is the conversation flow intuitive? Are threads easy to find and switch between? Is message composition straightforward? Does the real-time feel work?
